hook: Karen kicks the parking meter screen mid-rant, refusing to pay for parking
Karen slams an expired coupon on the scanner, screaming for a human cashier
Karen rings the doorbell 47 times demanding to speak to the homeowner
Karen screams her complicated order at the drive-thru speaker, demanding extra everything free
Karen tries to stop the robot vacuum with her foot, calling it a spy
Karen tailgates through the security gate dragging her designer purse, refusing to stop
Karen yanks the gas nozzle demanding a discount, threatening to call corporate
Karen stands on the porch mid-rant, screaming at the smart home hub on the wall
Karen shakes the vending machine violently after it eats her dollar
Karen reports the self-driving car 47 times, blocking it with her body
Karen pries the elevator doors open, demanding it skip her floor
Karen tries to push the smart cart past the wheel-lock line, wheels freeze
